subject: Changing geom_smooth params/methods based on number of data points

messages.author: 439a20c9d67ff394
messages.subject: Changing geom_smooth params/methods based on number of data points
parts:
I tend to use geom_smooth(aes(group=var)) quite a bit to create trend
lines within levels of a grouping variable (usually people). My
problem is that there are often different numbers of point at each
level which means I'd like to use different values for span, and maybe
even to switch down to method="lm" if the number of points gets too
small.

Is there a built in way to do this, or will I have to write my own
geom? If so, I'd appreciate any tips to get me started, as it would
be my first time creating a custom geom...

--

messages.subject: Re: Changing geom_smooth params/methods based on number of data  points
parts:
Instead of loess, you could try using gam from the mgcv package. That
should pick smoothness appropriate to the data, rather than you having
to set it manually.

Hadley
